book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN LUCAS

content: Comam Jesús yeb naj Zaqueo
Hayet yapni Comam Jesús bey Jericó, yecꞌ Comam yul con̈ob tuꞌ.
Haꞌ bey tuꞌ, ay huneꞌ naj winaj caw kꞌalom, Zaqueo isbi. Yahaw yeco naj yin̈ ebnaj ikꞌomilo tohlabal chito bey con̈ob Roma.
Naj Zaqueo tuꞌ, yoche naj yila Comam Jesús, yaj mach chiyu yilni naj yuto hantan̈e anma tzujanico yinta Comam, yebpaxo yu caw nichꞌan chꞌan istel naj.
Yuxin babicꞌo naj sata anma, yahto naj yin̈ iskꞌab huneꞌ teꞌ sicómoro aycan̈ istiꞌ beh, yu yilni naj Comam yet chꞌecꞌto bey tuꞌ.
Hayet yecꞌto Comam yich teꞌ, istꞌan̈xahto Comam yin̈ naj, yalni Comam tet naj: —Zaqueo, ayan̈ti yin̈ an̈e, yuto haꞌ bey hawatut chincanojan huneꞌ akꞌbal tiꞌ, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Hayet yaben naj Zaqueo huneꞌ tuꞌ, yin̈ an̈e ayti naj, isto naj. Caw xin chitzala iscꞌul naj yet ischahni naj Comam yul yatut.
Hayet yilni anma huneꞌ tuꞌ, yichico anma buchwal yin̈ Comam yuto cancano Comam bey yatut huneꞌ naj mulum.

Haꞌ naj Zaqueo tuꞌ, ah lin̈no naj, yalni naj tet Comam: —Mamin, wal tinan̈ chiwakꞌan yicta tzet ayinan tet anma mebaꞌ, yeb xin ta ay mac ecꞌbal wutelojan ismelyu, can̈elto ecꞌbal selel chiwakꞌan tet, ẍi naj.
Yalni Comam: —Mahul huneꞌ colbanile bey huneꞌ n̈a tiꞌ tinan̈; naj Zaqueo tiꞌ caw yuninalpaxo icham Abraham ye naj.
Wal xin Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, hulnajinan insayaꞌan yeb incolnihan anma cꞌaynato yu ismul, ẍi Comam.
Yechel yin̈ oxwan̈ ebnaj chahni chꞌen melyu

Yet lan̈an yaben anma yin̈ tzet chal Comam Jesús tuꞌ, lan̈anxa xin yapni Comam bey Jerusalén yoc yin̈ isnabal anma ta lan̈anxa yapni istiempohal bay chꞌoc Comam Dios Yahawilo anma, yuxin yicheco Comam yalni huneꞌ yechel tiꞌ.
Yalni Comam: —Yet hunel ay huneꞌ naj caw cꞌulticꞌa yin̈bal. Awtelax naj yul huneꞌ niman con̈ob yu ischahni naj yoc yahawilo yul iscon̈ob yet chimeltzohi.

Yet maẍto chito naj, yawte naj lahon̈wan̈ ebnaj chimunla yintaj, yakꞌnicano naj niman melyu tet hunun ebnaj yu ismunla ebnaj yeb chꞌen. Lahan yutecano naj isbisil chꞌen yin̈ ebnaj. Yalnicano naj tet ebnaj: “Munlahan̈we yeb chꞌen inmelyutiꞌan masanto yet chinhulan, cat heyakꞌni chꞌen yeb yal wetan,” ẍi naj, isto naj xin.

Yajaꞌ wal ebnaj yet con̈ob naj xin, caw chichiwa iscꞌul ebnaj yin̈ naj, yuxin yet isto naj, tzujanticꞌa yu isto huntekꞌan ebnaj akꞌocꞌule yin̈ naj tet naj awten naj tuꞌ, yalni ebnaj tet naj caw yahaw tuꞌ hacaꞌ ti: “Haꞌ huneꞌ naj tiꞌ caw mach chijochehan̈ chꞌoc naj yahawilo yul cocon̈oban̈,” ẍi ebnaj.

Yaj caw akꞌlaxticꞌa huneꞌ ismunil naj yoc yahawo iscon̈ob tuꞌ. Haxa yet ayxa naj yul iscon̈ob hunelxa, yawten naj ebnaj lahon̈wan̈ bay yakꞌ naj ismelyu tuꞌ yu iskꞌamben naj hantaxa yal chꞌen yikꞌ hunun ebnaj.
Yapni huneꞌ naj babel, yalni naj: “Mamin, haꞌ chꞌen hamelyu hawacano yul inkꞌaban, lahon̈ebto chꞌen wikꞌan yu chꞌen,” ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi naj yahaw tuꞌ tet naj: “Hach tiꞌ, caw cꞌul yu hamunla yin̈ hanicꞌchꞌan wacanojan tawet, yuxinto chaẍwacanicojan yahawo lahon̈eb con̈ob,” ẍi naj.
Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yapni hunxa naj munlawom, yalni naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mamin, haꞌ chꞌen hamelyu hawakꞌcano yul inkꞌaban, howeb to chꞌen wikꞌan yin̈ chꞌen,” ẍi naj.
Yalni naj yahaw tuꞌ tet naj: “Hach tiꞌ, chaẍwacanicojan yahawilo howeb con̈ob,” ẍi naj.
Lahwi tuꞌ xin yapni hunxa naj, yalni naj tet naj yahaw tuꞌ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mamin, ay hamelyu lah. Cꞌubabil chꞌen yul huneꞌ payuꞌe tiꞌ wuhan.

Caw quinxiwan intzabnihan hamelyu tiꞌ, yuto wohtajan ta caw how ach, yebpaxo toxan̈e chachah tzet ye tuꞌ maẍtajach watxꞌen̈e, yeb ton̈e chahatxꞌ tzet ye tuꞌ maẍtajach tzꞌunn̈e,” ẍi naj tet naj yahaw.
Yalni naj yahaw tuꞌ tet naj: “Walach hach tiꞌ, caw machiswalil yu hamunlahi, yu tzet maxawal wettiꞌan yuxin chaẍwacanicojan yin̈ isyaꞌtajil.
¿Tzet yin̈ yuxin mach hawakꞌ inmelyutiꞌan cꞌamil tet anma, haxinwal yet manhultiꞌan ayxa yal chꞌen chikꞌa?” ẍi naj.
Yalni xin naj yahaw tuꞌ tet ebnaj ayco iscꞌatan̈ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Iwelo chꞌen melyu tet naj tiꞌ, cat heyakꞌni chꞌen tet naj ikꞌni chꞌen lahon̈eb to,” ẍi naj yahaw tuꞌ.
Yalni ebnaj: “Mamin, yaj huneꞌ naj chawal tuꞌ, caw lahon̈ebxa chꞌen ecꞌbal ikꞌbil yu naj,” ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi naj yahaw tuꞌ xin: “Haꞌ mac ay yet, chꞌakꞌlax yakꞌbil tet, haꞌ mac machi yet, haꞌ nichꞌan ay yul iskꞌab tuꞌ, chiꞌilaxolo tet.
Yebpaxo xin, ebnaj ayco ishowal win̈an mach choche chinocan yahawilo yul con̈ob tiꞌ, iweti ebnaj bey tiꞌ, cat hepotxꞌni camo ebnaj yin̈ insatan,” ẍi naj yahaw tuꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Yet yocto Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Jerusalén
Lahwi yalni Comam Jesús huntekꞌan tuꞌ xin, isto Comam bey Jerusalén yeb ebnaj iscuywom.
Hayet ayco Comam yin̈ istzalanil won̈an Olivo, xolbal con̈ob Betfagé yeb con̈ob Betania, ischejnito Comam cawan̈ ebnaj iscuywom, yalni Comam tet ebnaj:
—Asiwe bey huneꞌ aldea cosatacꞌto tiꞌ. Yet chexapno bey tuꞌ, cheyilaꞌ huneꞌ noꞌ burro xecan, maẍto hunu mac chiꞌahto yiban̈ noꞌ. Chepuholo noꞌ, cat heyinoti noꞌ wetan, ẍi Comam.
Yalnipaxo Comam: —Ta ay mac chikꞌamben teyet, “¿Tzet yin̈ xin chepuhilo noꞌ?” ta ẍi, cheyalaꞌwe hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Ay chꞌocnico noꞌ yu Comam Jesús,” quexchi, ẍi Comam.
Isto ebnaj iscuywom tuꞌ, yilcha noꞌ yu ebnaj hacaꞌticꞌa yu yalni Comam.
Yet lan̈an ispuhnilo ebnaj noꞌ yapni ebnaj ay yet noꞌ tuꞌ, yalni ebnaj: —¿Tzet yuxin chepuhilo noꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —To ay chꞌocnico noꞌ yu Comam Jesús, ẍi ebnaj.
Lahwi tuꞌ xin yinito ebnaj noꞌ tet Comam, yanahto ebnaj huntekꞌan xil iskꞌap yiban̈ noꞌ, tzujan tuꞌ xin iscolwa ebnaj yanahto Comam yiban̈ noꞌ.
Hayet lan̈an yecꞌto Comam xin, islitxꞌbanayo anma xil iskꞌap yul beh sata Comam yu chitzala iscꞌul anma yin̈ Comam.
Hayet lan̈anxa yapni Comam yin̈ isxulanil won̈an Olivo tuꞌ, yah yaw sunil anma tzujan yinta Comam yu tzalahilal. Yalni anma cꞌulla tzotiꞌ yin̈ Comam Dios yu sunil cꞌaybalcꞌule xayil anma.
Chalni anma hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Jalaꞌwe cꞌulla tzotiꞌ yin̈ Jahawil chul coxol yu Comam Dios. Ayojab akꞌancꞌulal yul satcan̈, caw jakꞌaweco ismay Comam Dios.
Ay xin huntekꞌan ebnaj fariseo ayco xol anma tuꞌ, halni tet Comam: —Mam cuywawom, cach huntekꞌan anma chꞌel yaw tiꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.
Yalni Comam Jesús tet ebnaj: —Chiwalan teyet, ta chisbejaꞌ anma yelo yaw, haxam chꞌen chꞌen chiꞌaho yaw selelo anma tiꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Haxa yet lan̈anxa yapni Comam iscawilal con̈ob Jerusalén, yokꞌcan̈ Comam yilni con̈ob tuꞌ.

Yalni Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Tinan̈ xin, hex ah Jerusalén, majaltam yet huneꞌ tzꞌayic tiꞌ chinachalo heyu yin̈ huneꞌ mac chu yakꞌni akꞌancꞌulal yul heyanma, yaj wal xin mach chinachalo huneꞌ tiꞌ heyu yuto caw ewan ye yul hesat.
Cꞌanchꞌanex, ay huneꞌ tiempo bay chihulo isyaꞌtajil teyiban̈ yu anma ayco ishowal teyin̈. Chihoylaxayo hecon̈ob tiꞌ, hacaꞌ xan̈e peyab chuco ebnaj soldado, cat yanico ebnaj howal teyin̈.
Chitan̈tzelaxilo huneꞌ con̈ob tiꞌ. Matxa hunu chꞌen chꞌen chicancano yiban̈ yet chꞌenal, cat ispotxꞌlax camo sunil anma yuto mach hechah huneꞌ Mac Akꞌbilti texol Hecolomalo yu Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Yet istzumbenilti Comam Jesús anma chitxon̈wi yul yatut Comam Dios
Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yocto Comam Jesús yul yatut Comam Dios, istzumbenilti Comam anma chitxon̈wi bey tuꞌ.
Yalni Comam tet anma: —Tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yul Yum Comam Dios hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Haꞌ watutan yet txah yehi,” ẍicanoj. Yaj hex tiꞌ hacaꞌ hunu isn̈achꞌen elkꞌom ye heyu, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.

Hunun tzꞌayic isbey Comam Jesús cuywal yul yatut Comam Dios. Yajaꞌ ebnaj yahawil yeco yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ isley naj Moisés, yebpaxo ebnaj yahaw yeco yin̈ con̈ob, caw issay ebnaj tzet chute yakꞌni camo Comam.
Yajaꞌ mach chitxumcha yu ebnaj tzet chu ispotxꞌlax Comam, yuto caw ayco yanma sunil anma yaben tzet chal Comam.
